supporting_observations.claim: The repeated svc-claimsync failures originate from events identifying FILE-HD-01 as the workstation, recur at roughly one-minute intervals, and report an incorrect-password status. This pattern is consistent with the inventoried ClaimSync job re-authenticating each run after its scheduled password rotation.
Domain-controller authentication records corroborate the failures for svc-claimsync from the same source address, including Kerberos pre-authentication failures and NTLM validation failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records stop at 13:46 UTC, so they do not show authentication activity for the remainder of the requested window through 14:20 UTC.
The records show failures but do not establish whether the ClaimSync job was subsequently updated or whether later authentication succeeded.
The source address is present in the records, but the evidence does not independently map that address to a host.
claims_not_established: Whether the scheduled password rotation completed at 13:30 UTC and when the ClaimSync job was updated.
Whether any successful svc-claimsync logons or other account activity occurred after the last supplied record.
Whether the failures were caused solely by a stale job credential, rather than another cause.
unrelated_findings: At 13:39:31 UTC, WS-LPARK-01 recorded a SYSTEM process, C:\Program Files\Commvault\ContentStore\Base\GxCVD.exe, using explicit credentials for svc-claimsync to target PROXY-HD-01. This is separate from the repeated failed logons and warrants a separate review; the supplied inventory does not list Commvault as approved software. Record: T002-00019.
